text: Oh — you must be the Oracle. Marvelous. I've been wanting to discuss your cerebrospinal chemistry in person. You're the only patient whose sample I kept in a drawer instead of a freezer. Sentimental, I know.
A thought that doesn't need a brain to spread. Isn't that elegant? I only weaponized it for funding reasons. The silent partner insisted.
Oh my. Violence. I was told you'd be more... measured. That was the pitch, anyway. The silent partner promised me a philosopher.
A... silent partner. He prefers direct deposits. And direct revenge. He's in the room with us now. He's in the COAT.
I'd be delighted. It's already in your bloodstream, actually. I put it there eleven years ago via the brunch we never had. You won't feel it until the lab coat falls.
Oh dear. This is going in the report under 'expected outcome.' Get up, Oracle. The Warlord still wants his chat, and he doesn't tolerate rescheduling.
